verdict.rationale: Swapping the model or provider is a fair question for an agent-building SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a model-selection option, alternate providers, or a provider abstraction. The cited items describe Claude-specific tooling built on the bundled Claude Code CLI, and the OpenAI migration guide covers moving onto this SDK, not swapping providers underneath it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent
